comparator_baseline.name: World GDP last-observation carry-forward
comparator_baseline.prediction_rule: use GDP_2023 as the GDP_2024 prediction

uncertainty.method: deterministic WDI target-blind replay with 1 percent target tolerance

negative_controls.description: systems-last-observation-control: last-observation GDP_2023 baseline must have larger residual than the slope rule

falsifiers: held-out residual exceeds 1 percent of observed target or comparator is not worse
